_readme: CENTRAL AFFILIATE PRODUCT CONFIG. Articles reference products by ID only, e.g. ::product{id="sample-led-grow-light"}. To fix a dead or changed link, edit the 'url' on that one entry. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Every entry below is SAMPLE/PLACEHOLDER data with "placeholder": true — replace the URLs, names, images and prices with real ones and remove the placeholder flag. Amazon Associates rules restrict showing stale prices, so only keep 'price' if you update it; otherwise delete 'price' and 'priceChecked' and the box will just say 'Check price'.
